themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Comments on the wood-fired or chargrilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including flavor, sauce, size, doneness and how they compare with oysters elsewhere in New Orleans.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Comments on the fried alligator appetizer, including texture, tenderness, the chili garlic aioli or mayo, and whether it is worth trying.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Comments on the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the amount of rabbit, the stew or gravy, the dumplings and the seasoning.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon
themes.description: Comments on the signature Louisiana Cochon pulled pork patty with cabbage, turnips and cracklins, including its moisture, flavor and temperature.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Comments on the braised or paneed pork cheek dish, including tenderness, portion and flavor.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Comments on the smoked or BBQ pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, smokiness and spice.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Comments on the macaroni and cheese casserole side, including cheese flavor, texture, seasoning and whether it is a standout.

themes.name: Boudin balls
themes.description: Comments on the fried boudin balls with pickled peppers, including texture, flavor and dryness.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: Comments on the gumbo, including the chicken and andouille, duck or deviled egg versions, its color, spice, saltiness, portion and price.

themes.name: Beef brisket
themes.description: Comments on the smoked beef brisket with horseradish potato salad, including tenderness, fattiness, flavor and portion.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Comments on the complimentary rolls and bread basket, including their quality and whether or not the table received any.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Comments on the dessert menu, including pineapple upside-down cake, puddings, pies and cakes.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Comments on the cocktails, beer, wine and bourbon selection, including drink quality, strength, variety and drink prices.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Comments on the general salt level and seasoning across the menu, such as dishes that taste too salty, bland, over-peppered or under-seasoned.

themes.name: Prices and portion sizes
themes.description: Comments on how much dishes cost, how big the portions are, and whether the food is worth the money.

themes.name: Server attentiveness and pacing
themes.description: Comments on how attentive or absent servers were, order-taking and food delays, rushed meals, forgotten items, drink refills, being switched between servers, and menu knowledge.

themes.name: Staff attitude
themes.description: Comments on the friendliness, warmth, courtesy or rudeness of staff toward guests, including servers, bartenders, hosts and managers, and how they handled complaints or special requests.

themes.name: Reservations and seating waits
themes.description: Comments on making or honoring reservations, wait times for a table, host stand seating decisions, table assignments and walk-in or party-size policies.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: Comments on the decor, ambiance, music, noise level, temperature and seating comfort of the dining room.
